purpose: Teach: 西川/横山/藤本/新田/飯田/西尾/木下/秋山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の西川先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit the research direction from your mentor, Professor Nishikawa.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority. Slight pause before the name — weight of expectation. Calm but unmistakable: this is instruction, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。横山教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Yokoyama's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quick affirmative. Earnest and eager, almost leaning forward in the voice. No hesitation — he's already mentally organizing where to start.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の藤本先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Fujimoto about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Steady directive. The name lands with quiet significance. Expectation that Ren will handle this with appropriate care and formality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で新田助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Nitta's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Quick tempo. A note of genuine interest underneath — he's already picturing the event, taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、引退する飯田先生のご研究をまとめろ
lines.en: Ren — compile the research of Professor Iida, who's retiring.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. This task carries weight. Slight emphasis on 「引退」 — this is an honor, a responsibility. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。西尾広報担当に研究成果を伝えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to communicate the research outcomes to Nishio in PR.
lines.style: Polite, composed. Slightly more formal register than his previous responses. Shows he understands this bridges research and administration — careful handling required.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の木下技術員と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate closely with Kinoshita, our lab technician.
lines.style: Practical, clear. The name lands without ceremony — this is about workflow, collaboration. Tone: this person matters to how things actually work here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。秋山主任研究員のご指導を受けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll seek guidance from Akiyama, our senior research fellow.
lines.style: Respectful close. Slight uptick in formality and warmth — deference but not obsequiousness. The acknowledgment of someone's seniority and wisdom, genuine and brief.
